content.comment_body: When I checked online, no values were shown on the web page.
To display values on the web server via the virtual screen of the main module or display unit, you need to create message texts and enable the web server option.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reported that values were missing from the web screen of the product's web interface, suggesting some confusion or lack of clear instructions for visualizing data online. Another user explained that message texts must be created and relevant settings enabled in the web server configuration for values to be visible, exposing a challenge in accessibility and guidance within the documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects values to automatically appear on the web screen of the product’s web application without needing additional or unclear setup steps.
